description: This file defines the Order controller class for generating and managing order report tasks in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for scheduling report tasks and retrieving order statistics such as sales, processing, completed, and other orders.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing order report tasks and statistics in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Schedules report tasks for sale, processing, complete, and other order statuses.

methods.name: sale
methods.description: Retrieves total sales for completed orders and updates statistics.

methods.name: processing
methods.description: Retrieves total processing orders and updates statistics.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Retrieves total completed orders and updates statistics.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Retrieves total orders with statuses outside of complete and processing, and updates statistics.
